summary: Requirements re-grill of the confirmed spec against repo reality. Eleven findings, and the two that mattered most were criteria of mine that were simply FALSE about the code. C7 had the server deriving subtotal composition from the mapping master, but parent/child structure lives in the pinned OUTLINE SNAPSHOT and decision 0024 requires aggregate behaviour to be a client projection - so aggregates now project the attested statement payload and name descendant lines WITH THEIR VALUES, which is also a better answer. And C9's absolute 'no amount reaches the model' was unimplementable, because the user's own question carries the number - 'how is this 85000' is the motivating example - so C9 now binds SERVER-SOURCED data only. The read also showed the existing causal guard does not classify 'how is this' as causal at all, so the boundary is a fixture table the tests own rather than prose. The human chose an attested statement context over a weaker scope-only check, which is what finally makes C14's tamper refusal honest, and chose to keep /ask isolated in RENDERING as well as sending - the shared AskProvider would otherwise have shown a grounded turn on the screen they froze. Recorded at the spec gate against the amended spec, whose delivery route for the attested context the human settled: it is an additive field on the existing statement response rather than a second endpoint that could drift from the screen.
gaps: Nothing in the request proved it was about the RENDERED statement. C14 required a tampered node, block or pin set to be refused, but a client-held request cannot distinguish tampering from another valid on-screen leaf or a valid historical batch - re-derivation protects scope, it does not prove screen identity - so C1, C2 and C14 could not all hold.

C7 said the server derives subtotal composition from the mapping master with no warehouse read. That cannot work: parent/child structure lives in the pinned OUTLINE SNAPSHOT, not the mapping master, and decision 0024 requires aggregate drill behaviour to be a client projection of the statement payload. A labels-only answer would also have failed the stated purpose of showing which amounts add up to the figure.

The intent and model-data boundary was wrong in two ways. The cited guard does NOT classify 'how is this 85000' as causal today - it matches 'why', 'reason' and 'explain' - so the boundary had to be built rather than assumed. And C9's absolute 'no amount ever reaches the model' was impossible as written, because decision 0027 permits a user's QUESTION to contain numbers and the ordinary data path still uses the model to select a governed query.

No rule covered client-supplied department or function disagreeing with the plant's master selection. The current resolver uses those as lookup KEYS while C2 says the server derives them, so one implementation could silently substitute and another return an ordinary 'no mapping' result.

Behaviour before a focus exists was contradictory: 'no rendered statement' conflicted with preserving ungrounded behaviour, and 'no focus asks the user to click' conflicted with the ordinary-data arm, so an answerable data question would have been met with a request to click a line.

No typed response existed to carry the explanation or the stale detail. AskResponse has no explanation payload, and the global exception path discards exactly the source, period and status C11 requires. C10 and C12 also applied audit requirements to EVERY explanation while C7 said aggregates have no governed-read audit.

'Budget not loaded' was incoherent across criteria: C8 prohibited Budget as a subject while C13 said a non-owner plant 'returns' the Budget-not-loaded state, and the budget batch is also the pinned OUTLINE source even for a non-owner plant.

Ownership of focus, block and the 'open full drill' action was unassigned. StatementView owns the drill internally while AskPanel is its sibling, there is no report-wide selected-block control - the block is known only once an Actual is clicked - and the spec required both a shared focus and an assistant control that opens the existing panel.

'/ask untouched' covered only what /ask SENDS. The dock and /ask share an AskProvider and turns survive navigation, so a grounded explanation could have rendered on /ask - a turn type it has never displayed - breaking the constraint in a way no leaf was asked to catch.

C14 mandated a vitest discriminator for every criterion, but the security, audit, provider-payload and tamper proofs are BACKEND leaves and this repo runs those under Node's test runner. A vitest-only criterion could not prove the server guarantees at all.
REPOSITORY-ONLY: the derived roadmap item did not carry C8, C12, C13 or C14's proof matrix, so planning could have satisfied the roadmap while silently omitting confirmed requirements.

The attested context had no delivery route. It must reach the client somehow, and the choice has real blast radius: adding it to the shipped MIS statement response touches a contract the report screen, the export and their leaves already depend on, while a separate endpoint would re-derive the statement scope a second time and could drift from the statement actually on screen - defeating the point of attestation.
resolutions: RESOLVED by the human: the statement response now carries a server-issued ATTESTED CONTEXT binding scope, outline, pins, master version, user/session and expiry. The assistant returns it, and focus may be any valid Actual inside that attested statement, with no per-click round trip. C14's refusal set is restated as an invalid, expired or other-user context, or a node/block absent from the attested outline - it no longer calls a different valid node in the same statement 'tampering'.

RESOLVED: an aggregate explanation is a CLIENT PROJECTION of the attested statement payload per decision 0024, naming the descendant lines WITH THEIR VALUES plus their approved mapping metadata, with structure taken from the pinned outline snapshot. No raw rows, no query, no governed-read audit; and a labels-only answer explicitly does not satisfy the criterion.

RESOLVED: intent resolves against a FIXTURE TABLE the tests own - 'how is this / what makes up / break down' to composition, a causal cue winning when both appear, everything else falling through to the existing data path - and C9 is scoped to SERVER-SOURCED transaction, result, batch and measure data. The user's own question and prior-turn text may carry figures, which the motivating question requires.

RESOLVED: a mismatch in an attested grounded request is a TYPED REFUSAL. The server derives the canonical values from the master's selection for that plant; the client's copies are verified context, never authority.

RESOLVED by an explicit outcome table in the spec: with no statement or no mapping the dock says 'Generate a mapped statement first' locally and submits no grounded ask; with a statement but nothing clicked, composition asks for a click, causal is declined and an ordinary data question uses the existing ungrounded path; with an Actual focused, the three-arm behaviour applies.

RESOLVED: the explanation is an in-band TYPED RESPONSE UNION on the existing chat transport with a variant per outcome - focus-required, leaf, aggregate, replaced, gone, and safe audit-failure - and C10/C12 now bind ONLY leaf raw reads. Aggregates stay query-free with no governed-read audit, and a failed audit returns the safe refusal without ever running the query.

RESOLVED: every grounded explanation carries a distinct budgetState of not-loaded when applicable, while Budget stays non-focusable with no composition answer. The outline's budget pin is still attested and validated because it is the outline source, and its replaced or gone status stays distinct from the ordinary not-loaded state.

RESOLVED: the MIS report view owns the shared statement context and the focused nodeKey/block. There is no independent selected block before focus, so the block always comes from the focused node; clicking an Actual both opens today's drill and sets focus, so drill-down does not regress; and the assistant's action opens that same panel.

RESOLVED by the human: /ask stays fully isolated in rendering as well as sending. Grounded turns are partitioned to the docked panel and are not shown on /ask, and C14 requires a leaf proving both halves.

RESOLVED: each leaf is judged by the discriminator for its own runner - frontend by vitest (present AND NOT skipped AND NOT failed, D-0031) and backend by Node/JUnit, where a non-matching name yields a testcase named for the FILE PATH (D-0024). No test-runner migration is implied.

RESOLVED: the roadmap item's acceptance criteria are extended to carry the attested context, the budget state, the typed response union and the per-runner proof matrix, so the roadmap and the confirmed spec say the same thing.

RESOLVED by the human: the context is an ADDITIVE field on the existing statement response. The statement already computes everything the context binds - scope, outline, pins, master version - so it signs and returns it in the same round trip with no extra call and no second derivation. Existing consumers keep working; the shipped contract's leaves are re-proven as part of the story.

rounds.question: The attested context has to reach the client somehow. Adding it to the existing MIS statement response touches a contract the shipped report screen, its export and its tests already depend on. Where should it come from?
options: Add it to the statement response (Recommended)
rounds.chosen: Add it to the statement response (Recommended)
